curl -s http://127.0.0.1:46001/color.png -o /tmp/c.png && python3 -c "
import zlib,struct
d=open('/tmp/c.png','rb').read()
i=8;idat=b''
while i<len(d):
  l=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0];t=d[i+4:i+8]
  if t==b'IHDR':print(struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',d[i+8:i+8+13]))
  if t==b'IDAT':idat+=d[i+8:i+8+l]
  i+=12+l
r=zlib.decompress(idat);print(r[:16].hex(),len(r))"
